test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper marks the price of an article at ₹5,960. Find the cost price if after allowing a discount of 9% he still gains 30% on the cost price.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the article = ₹5,960

Discount = 9%

Gain on cost price = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (C.P) = Selling Price (S.P) / (1 + Gain%)

Selling Price (S.P) = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

**Calculation:**

Selling Price (S.P) = 5,960 × (1 - 9/100)

Selling Price (S.P) = 5,960 × (91/100)

Selling Price (S.P) = ₹5,419.60

Cost Price (C.P) = S.P / (1 + 30/100)

Cost Price (C.P) = 5,419.60 / (1.3)

⇒ Cost Price (C.P) = ₹4,169.69

Correct answer (closest to C.P) = ₹4,172

**The cost price is ₹4,172.**
